title: Reflection
summary: The law of reflection, the normal, and the difference between regular and diffuse reflection.

ib.note: Refraction and Snell’s law follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 11: Light: Shadows and Reflections
Curiosity Ch 10: Light: Mirrors and Lenses (laws of reflection)

objectives: I can state and use the law of reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection.
I can measure angles from the normal.
I can explain the difference between regular and diffuse reflection.
misconceptions: Angles are measured from the mirror surface (they are measured from the normal).
